text:
tess-ae: LedgerFlow asked for a 3-week proof-of-value for invoice ingestion + question answering. They want clear success gates and a minimal security checklist before data ingestion. Can we scope today?

anita-se: main flows: 1) PDF invoices (single + multi-page) -> structured extraction, 2) follow-up Q&A over a document, 3) reconcile line-items against an order system (mocked).

kevin-ml: for the eval harness i'm thinking: golden set = 120 redacted real invoices + 50 synthetic edge cases (noisy OCR, rotated pages). scoring: field-level token F1 for extraction, and binary human pass/fail for Q&A responses.

omar-infra: infra guidance: to hit sub-300ms p95 at 10 QPS avg with ~400 tokens, Dedicated micro pool (2 GPUs) should work. EU data residency ok in eu-west-1.

paul-legal: legal asks: DPA signed? They require data processing addendum, deletion SLA 30 days, and restrictions on downstream model training. We need to confirm we won't persist raw customer docs outside their tenancy.

maya-sec: security must-haves: allowlist CIDRs, TLS-only endpoints, KMS for at-rest keys, audit-log forwarding. If they require BYOK + annual pen test report that's an enterprise approval path.

anita-se: acceptance gates proposal: - Extraction: per-field F1 >= 0.86 across golden set. - Q&A: human-eval pass rate >= 80% on 100 queries. - Latency: p95 <= 350ms in Dedicated. - No sampled PII leakage in 50 red-team prompts.

kevin-ml: regression policy: nightly batch compare vs baseline model on golden set. Trigger alert if extraction F1 drops >3% absolute or Q&A pass rate drops >6%. Auto-rollback only for severe latency regressions or F1 drop >6%.

tess-ae: timeline requested by customer: start Mon, deliver final report in 3 weeks. Week1 = data intake + golden set build, Week2 = model iterations + infra tuning, Week3 = regression runs + human eval + wrap. Is that feasible?

omar-infra: feasible if we get 50 sample invoices (redacted) by Tue noon. i'll reserve eu-west Dedicated capacity.

paul-legal: also confirm they are not subject to HIPAA. if they are, we need extra privacy controls.

anita-se: on golden set composition: prefer at least 80 real redacted samples, include 10 scanned images, 10 hand-filled, 20 vendor-template variants. seed prompt template below:```
SYSTEM: You are an invoice parsing assistant. Extract fields: invoice_id, date, total_amount, vendor, billing_address, line_items [{description, qty, unit_price}]. Return JSON only.
USER: <OCR_or_raw_text>
ASSISTANT: {"invoice_id":"","date":"","total_amount":"","vendor":"","billing_address":"","line_items":[]}
```

kevin-ml: also propose storing model outputs + annotator judgements for each golden example in the harness so we can compute per-field drift and precision/recall over time.

maya-sec: for data intake, send encrypted S3 presigned URL or SFTP. do not email attachments.

tess-ae: customer question on cost: they asked for a 3-week estimate comparing hosted vs Dedicated. rough numbers?

omar-infra: rough: hosted trial ~ $5-9k for 3 weeks depending on usage; Dedicated prorated commit ~ $3.5-5k + eval infra. i'll produce a detailed sim by EOD.

tess-ae: blockers: 1) legal signoff on DPA, 2) redacted samples by Tue, 3) sec checklist answers (CIDRs, BYOK?) from LedgerFlow.

paul-legal: i'll draft a minimal DPA addendum and share a checklist of the clauses they usually need.

deploy-bot: staging env ledgerflow-invoice-poc is up: https://staging.ledgerflow.redwood.internal credentials in 1Password.

tess-ae: next steps i will: send scope + timeline + DPA draft to LedgerFlow today, request sample upload instructions, and book kick-off on Monday.

anita-se: i'll prepare the golden prompt set + annotation schema by Monday EOD. kevin, can you prep annotators for week3?

kevin-ml: yes, i've booked 3 annotators and a QA lead for week3. will also instrument per-field dashboards in Console.

maya-sec: i'm available to review the questionnaire answers once they upload. ping me if they request pen test artifacts.
